title: Always searching
content: I find myself in these type of stores a lot in my dreams. My favorite is the crystal stores looking for the best crystal that catches my eye. I also dream of these book stores and even craft stores full of stuff. Of course there is the classic dream of the grocery store with the yellow lighting and long empty aisles of food. In waking life I go thrifting a lot so it makes sense for my dreams to appear this way.
